text: Search API returns real-time, ranked web results as structured data for your own processing
quote: Get raw, ranked web search results with advanced filtering and real-time data.

text: Search results can be filtered or controlled by domain
quote: Perplexity's Search API returns real-time, ranked web results as structured data, with controls for domains, languages, regions, and extracted content.

text: Search results can be targeted by language and region
quote: Perplexity's Search API returns real-time, ranked web results as structured data, with controls for domains, languages, regions, and extracted content.

text: Search API supports multi-query search and content extraction from result pages
quote: Access real-time web search results with Perplexity's Search API. Get ranked results, domain filtering, multi-query search, and content extraction for developers.

text: Search context size setting controls how much web information is retrieved per request
quote: Search context determines how much web information is retrieved. Higher context = more comprehensive results.

text: Embeddings API generates embeddings for semantic search and RAG pipelines
quote: Generate high-quality embeddings for semantic search and RAG pipelines.

text: Pro Search runs multi-step reasoning with automated tool use, doing multiple web searches and URL fetches to answer complex queries
quote: Pro Search enhances Sonar Pro with automated tool usage and multi-step reasoning. When enabled, the model can perform multiple web searches and fetch URL content to answer complex queries.

text: Official MCP server lets AI assistants use Perplexity search and reasoning inside their workflows
quote: The Perplexity MCP Server enables AI assistants to access Perplexity's powerful search and reasoning capabilities directly within their workflows.

text: Hosted remote MCP server at api.perplexity.ai/mcp that needs no installation or updates
quote: Remote MCP server (recommended): hosted by Perplexity at `https://api.perplexity.ai/mcp`. No installation, nothing to update, works with any client that supports remote MCP servers.

text: Open-source local MCP server runs over stdio and can be pinned to a version
quote: Local MCP server: run the open-source server on your machine over stdio. Use this if your client only supports stdio servers or you need to pin a version.

text: MCP clients can delegate complex multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results
quote: your MCP client can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results.

text: Agents can call your own remote MCP servers, discovering their tools, with approvals to review each call before it runs
quote: Your own remote MCP server. The model discovers and calls the server's tools... use approvals to review each call before it runs.

text: Official type-safe SDKs are available for integration
quote: Install one of our official SDKs for a convenient, type-safe integration

text: SDK has type definitions for all request params and response fields, with both synchronous and asynchronous clients
quote: The library includes type definitions for all request params and response fields, and offers both synchronous and asynchronous clients powered by httpx

text: Async SDK client can use aiohttp instead of httpx as the HTTP backend for better concurrency
quote: By default, the async client uses `httpx` for HTTP requests. However, for improved concurrency performance you may also use `aiohttp` as the HTTP backend.

text: SDK automatically retries certain errors twice by default with exponential backoff
quote: Certain errors are automatically retried 2 times by default, with a short exponential backoff.

text: SDK raises typed APIStatusError subclasses carrying status_code and response for 4xx/5xx responses
quote:
When the API returns a non-success status code (that is, 4xx or 5xx
response), a subclass of `perplexity.APIStatusError` is raised, containing `status_code` and `response` properties.

text: Supports streaming responses via Server-Sent Events
quote: We provide support for streaming responses using Server Side Events (SSE).

text: Official pplx CLI runs search from the terminal and returns ranked results as JSON for shell pipelines and agent tool calls
quote: You can now run Perplexity Search straight from your terminal. The Perplexity CLI returns the same ranked results as JSON, ready for shell pipelines and agent tool calls, with no code to write.

text: Interactive Playground lets you try Perplexity Search without an API key
quote: You can also [try Perplexity Search in the interactive Playground](https://console.perplexity.ai/project/playground/search) with no API key required.

text: Usage tiers advance automatically with spend, raising rate limits, and reached tiers are kept permanently
quote: As you spend more on API credits over time, you automatically advance to higher tiers with increased rate limits. Higher tiers unlock significantly more requests per minute, and once you reach a tier, you keep it permanently with no downgra

text: Pay-as-you-go pricing for all APIs with no subscription required
quote: Pay-as-you-go pricing for all APIs. No subscription required.

text: Every API response includes exact token counts so per-request costs are known
quote: every API response includes exact token counts so you know your costs per request.

text: Flex (0.5x) and priority (2x) service tiers change token rates for supported models
quote: The `flex` (0.5×) and `priority` (2×) service tiers change the token rates only for models that list that tier

text: Access third-party models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI and others through one API without managing multiple keys
quote: Access OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, and more through one unified API, no need to manage multiple API keys.

text: Open-weight models hosted by Perplexity are available through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint
quote: Unified access to open-weight models hosted by Perplexity through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

text: Accepts OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, or Anthropic Messages request formats and routes to a healthy deployment automatically
quote: Send requests in the OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, or Anthropic Messages format, pick any model from the catalog, and the platform routes each request to a healthy deployment automatically — no per-provider accounts, SDKs, or f

text: Orchestrator API is a drop-in replacement for OpenAI or Anthropic integrations by changing only base URL and API key
quote: This makes the Orchestrator API a drop-in replacement for existing OpenAI or Anthropic integrations — only the base URL and API key need to change.

text: POST /v1/responses is accepted as an alias for OpenAI SDK compatibility
quote: For OpenAI SDK compatibility, `POST /v1/responses` is also accepted as an alias.

text: Failed requests from provider errors, rate limits, or timeouts are retried on another deployment of the same model
quote: When a deployment fails — a provider error, a rate limit, or a timeout — the request is retried on another deployment for that model when one is available.

text: Multi-turn conversations stay on the same deployment so prompt caching and cache-read pricing apply automatically
quote: Multi-turn conversations are kept on the same deployment where possible, so prompt caching keeps working across requests — send the same conversation prefix and you benefit from cache-read pricing without doing anything special.

text: Model fallback tries each model in a models array in order until one succeeds
quote: Model fallback enables specifying multiple models in a `models` array. The API tries each model in order until one succeeds, providing automatic failover when a model is unavailable.

text: Presets provide a ready-made agent configuration in a single field
quote: A `preset` gives you a working agent in one field.

text: Effort levels can be pinned to a released version to keep a fixed configuration after the level changes
quote: call an effort level with a version (e.g., `effort="fast@2026-10-16.0"`) to keep running one released configuration after the effort level moves on.

text: Reusable, versioned saved profiles can be selected by ID instead of repeating configuration per request
quote: A profile is a reusable, versioned configuration that you save and manage. ... Select a profile by ID instead of repeating the full configuration in every request.

text: Agent API takes instructions as a persistent system prompt separate from per-turn input
quote: `instructions` is the agent's **system prompt** — the rules that hold on every turn. `input` is the specific thing to do this turn.

text: Conversations continue from a prior response via previous_response_id without resending history
quote: For most multi-turn conversations, use `previous_response_id` to continue from a completed prior response without resending the conversation yourself.

text: Built-in Perplexity-hosted tools for web search and URL fetch are enabled by type, with results returned inline
quote: Built-in tools | Perplexity-hosted capabilities: web search, URL fetch, people and finance search, and a code sandbox. Enable each by `type`, and Perplexity runs it and returns the results inline.

text: Built-in people search and finance search tools are available to agents
quote: Perplexity-hosted capabilities: web search, URL fetch, people and finance search, and a code sandbox. Enable each by `type`

text: Sandbox tool gives the agent an isolated Linux container to run real code and use the output in answers
quote: The `sandbox` tool gives the agent an isolated Linux container to run real code and use the output in its answer — for results that must be exact, like a computed number, a transformed dataset, or a generated report.

text: Tool availability can be restricted by disabling tools by default and enabling selected ones
quote: To restrict which tools the model can call, disable tools by default and enable the ones you want

text: Custom function tools pause the run and hand you arguments to execute, then continue when you return the result
quote: You declare the schema, and when the model calls one, the run pauses and hands you the arguments to execute, then continues once you return the result.

text: Structured output returns JSON conforming to a user-defined schema
quote: Structured output makes the model return JSON that conforms to a schema you define, so you can deserialize it directly.

text: Computer agent browses the web including login-gated pages, runs code in a sandbox, and creates PDFs, slides, spreadsheets, images, and videos
quote: Computer can: Search and browse the web for real-time information, including login-gated pages ... Write and execute code in an interactive Linux sandbox ... Create documents and media including PDFs, slide decks, spreadsheets, images, and

text: Returns typed answers with calibrated probabilities for yes/no, multiple-choice, and rubric questions about text, JSON, or images
quote: Calibrated probabilities for yes/no, multiple-choice, and rubric questions about text, JSON, or images.
